अप अप, ind. (as a prefix to nouns and
verbs, expresses) away, off, back, (opposed to उप,
अनु, सम्, प्र), down (opposed to उद्).
When prefixed to nouns, it may sometimes = the
neg. particle अ, e. g. अप-भी, fearless; or may ex-
press deterioration, inferiority, &c., e. g. अप-पाठ,
q. v.
(As a separable preposition or adverb, with abl.)
away from, on the outside of, without, with the ex-
ception of. It is separated only in the Vedas [cf. Gr.
ἀπό Lat. ab; Goth. af; Eng. of].

अप्प अप्प, अस्, m., N. of an author of a
book on prosody.

1. आप, अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of compounds; e. g.
दुर्-आप, difficult to be obtained.

आप 2. आप, अस्, m. (probably connected
with अप्, आपस्, q. v.), N. of one of the eight demi-
gods called Vasus. (For 1. आप see above.)

आपा आ-पा, cl. 1. P. -पिबति or -पिवति,
पातुम्, to drink up, to drink out of or at; to drink
with the ears or eyes, hear, see: Caus. -पाययति,
-यितुम्, to cause to drink.
अपकरुण अप-करुण, अस्, आ, अम्, cruel.

अपकलङ्क अप-कलङ्क, अस्, m. an indelible
disgrace, a deep stain.

अपकल्मष अप-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, stain-
less.

अपकष् अप-कष्, cl. 1. P. -कषति, -षितुम्,
to scrape off.

अपकाम अप-काम, अस्, m., Ved. aversion,
abhorrence; abominableness; deprivation of what is
dear; (अम्), ind. against one's liking, unwillingly.
अपकीर्ति अप-कीर्ति, इस्, f. infamy, disgrace.

अपकुक्षि अप-कुक्षि, इस्, m. a bad or ill-
shaped belly (?). This word may also be used as a
बहु-व्रीहि and as an अव्ययी-भाव.

अपकुञ्ज अप-कुञ्ज, अस्, m., N. of a younger
brother of the serpent king Śeṣa.

अपकृ अप-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to carry away, remove, drag away; (with
gen. or acc.) to hurt, wrong, injure (any one): Caus.
-कारयति, -यितुम्, to hurt, wrong.

अपाकृ अपा-कृ (अप-आ˚), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, or Ved. -कर्तोस्, to remove,
drive away, keep away; to take away; to reject (an
opinion); to cast off, reject; to desist from, to drop;
to free one's self from; to pay.

अपाकॄ अपा-कॄ (अप-आ˚), cl. 6. P. -किरति,
-करितुम्, -रीतुम्, to throw any one off; to abandon
to contemn.

अप-करण, अम्, n. acting improperly; doing
wrong; ill-treating, offending, injuring.

अपा-करण, अम्, n. driving away, removal; pay-
ment, liquidation.

अप-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, injurious, offensive, hos-
tile, inimical, an enemy.

अप-कर्मन्, अ, n. discharge (of a debt); evil doing,
improper conduct, wickedness; oppression, violence;
laziness, incompetence; any impure or degrading act
or rite.
अपा-कर्मन्, अ, n. payment, liquidation.

अप-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, acting wrong, offending;
(अस्), m. wrong, offence, injury, hurt; wickedness;
oppression, enmity.
—अपकार-गिर्, ईस्, f. or अप-
कार-शब्द, अस्, m. an offending or menacing speech.
—अपकार-ता, f. wrong, offence.
—अपकारार्थिन्
(˚र-अर्˚), ई, इनी, इ, malicious, malevolent.

आपकर आपकर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अप-कर),
offensive, mischievous, unfriendly.

अप-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अप-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
(with gen.) acting wrong, doing ill (to any one),
offending, injuring.

अप-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done wrong, maliciously,
offensively or wickedly committed; observed or
practised as a degrading or impure act, as servile
duties, funeral rites, &c.; (अम्), n. injury, offence.

अपा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, removed, de-
stroyed, void of; paid.

अप-कृति, इस्, f. oppression, wrong, injury; en-
mity, opposition; any degrading or impure act or
rite.
अपा-कृति, इस्, f. taking away, removal.
अपा-कृति; add — evil conduct.
अप-कृत्य, अम्, n. damage, injury, hurt.

अप-क्रिया, f. delivery, clearing off (debts); offence;
any impure act or rite.

अपकृत् अप-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्-
तितुम्, to cut off.

अपकृष् अप-कृष्, cl. 1. and 6. P. A. -कर्ष्-
अति, -ते, -कृषति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्,
to draw off or aside, drag down, carry away, take
away, remove; to omit, diminish; to put away; to
anticipate something which occurs later (as a word of
a sentence); to bend (a bow); to detract, debase,
dishonour: Caus. -कर्षयति, -यितुम्, to remove,
diminish, detract.

अपाकृष् अपा-कृष् (अप-आ˚), cl. 1. 6. P. A.
-कर्षति, -ते, -कृषति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्,
to turn off or away, to avert.

अप-कर्ष, अस्, m. drawing or dragging off or
down, detraction, deficiency, diminution, decay; low-
ering, deterioration, depression; decline, degradation,
inferiority, infamy; anticipated performance of a
duty; (in poetry) anticipation of a word occurring
later.
—अपकर्ष-सम, अस्, आ, m. f. a sophism
in the Nyāya, e. g. ‘sound has not the quality of
shape as a jar has, therefore sound and a jar have no
qualities in common.’

अप-कर्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, drawing down, de-
tracting (with gen.).

अप-कर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, taking away, forcing
away, removing, diminishing; (अम्), n. taking
away, depriving of; drawing down; abolishing, de-
nying.

अप-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn away, taken away,
removed, lost; dragged down, brought down, de-
pressed; low, vile, inferior; (अस्), m. a crow.
—अप-
कृष्ट-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, mentally debased.
—अप-
कृष्ट-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of a low tribe.
—अपकृष्ट-
ता, f. or अपकृष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. inferiority, vileness.

अपकौशली अप-कौशली, f. news, informa-
tion.

अपक्ति अ-पक्ति, इस्, f. (rt. पच्), immaturity;
indigestion.

अ-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, unripe, immature; undi-
gested.
—अपक्व-ता, f. immaturity; incompleteness.
—अपक्व-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, of immature under-
standing.
—अपक्वाशिन् (˚व-आश्˚), ई, इनी, इ, eating
raw, uncooked food.

आपक्व आ-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. पच् with 3. आ,
implying diminution), half-baked, crude, raw; nearly
ripe, not quite ripe; undressed, what is eaten without
further preparation (as bread &c.).

अपक्रम् अप-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, poet.
A. -क्रमते, -मितुम्, to go away, fly, retreat, re-
tire from; to glide away; to measure off by steps.

अपाक्रम् अपा-क्रम् (अप-आ˚), cl. 1. P. poet.
A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to retire from.

अप-क्रम, अस्, m. going away; passing off or
away; flight, retreat.

अप-क्रमण, अम्, n. or अप-क्राम, अस्, m.
passing off or away, retiring.
अप-क्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going away, retiring.

अपक्री अप-क्री, cl. 9. P. A. -क्रीणाति, -णीते,
-क्रेतुम्, to buy, purchase.

अपक्रुश् अप-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति, -क्रोष्-
टुम्, to revile.
अप-क्रोश, अस्, m. reviling, abusing.

अपक्ष अ-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, without wings;
not on the same side or party; adverse, opposed to.
—अपक्ष-ता, f. opposition, hostility.
—अ-पक्ष-
पात, अस्, m. impartiality.

अपाक्ष अपाक्ष (अप-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pre-
sent, perceptible; (अस्, ई, अम्), eyeless, having bad
eyes.

अपक्षि अप-क्षि, cl. 5. 9. or 1. P. -क्षिणोति,
-क्षिणाति, -क्षयति, -क्षेतुम्, to destroy, anni-
hilate; bring to an end: Pass. -क्षीयते, to decline,
wane (as the moon).
अप-क्षय, अस्, m. decline, decay, wane.
अप-क्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, waned.

अप-क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, declined, decayed, di-
minished.

अपक्षिप् अप-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति,
-ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw away or down, take away,
remove.

अप-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast down or
away.

अप-क्षेपण, अम्, n. casting away, throwing
down.

अपगम् अप-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go away, depart; to give way, vanish.

अप-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going away, turning away;
(आ), f. a river.

अपगा अप-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to
go away, vanish, retire.

आपगा आपगा, f. (fr. rt. गा with अप ?), a
river, a stream; N. of a stream.

अप-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, departed, remote,
gone off; dead, diseased.
—अपगत-व्याधि, इस्, इस्,
इ, one who has recovered from a disease.

अप-गम, अस्, m. or अप-गमन, अम्, n. going
away; giving way; separation, departure, death.
अपगर अप-गर, अस्, m. (rt. गॄ), reviler.

अपगर्जित अप-गर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, thunder-
less (as a cloud).

अपगल्भ अप-गल्भ, अस्, m., Ved. failing in
boldness; abortive; being on the side (not in the
middle ?); separated from the oldest by one.

अपगुर् अप-गुर्, cl. 6. A. -गुरते, some-
times P. -गुरति, -रितुम्, to reject, disapprove,
threaten; to inveigh against any one; to deprive
of (?): part. of the Intens. अप-जर्गुराण, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. rejecting, &c.
अप-गारम् or अप-गोरम्, ind. having raised.

अपगुह् अप-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते,
गूहितुम्, -गोढुम्, to conceal, hide.
अप-गोह, अस्, m., Ved. hiding place; secret.

अपगोपुर अप-गोपुर, अस्, आ, अम्, without
gates (as a town).

अपग्रह् अप-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति,
-णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to take away, disjoin, tear off.

अपघन अप-घन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with
अप), a limb or member, as a hand or foot.

अप-घात, अस्, m. striking or cutting off; ward-
ing off; killing; a violent death.
अप-घातक, अस्, इका, अम्, warding off.

अप-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, murderous, killing. See
अप-हन्.
अप-घातिन्, अप-जिघांसु. See s. v.
अपङ्क्त्य अपङ्क्त्य. See अपाङ्क्त्य.

अपच अ-पच or अ-पचमान, अस्, m. not
cooking; not being able to cook; a bad cook.

अपचर् अप-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रितुम्,
to depart; to act wrongly.

अप-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone away, departed,
dead; (अम्), n. fault, offence.

अप-चार, अस्, m. want, absence; defect; fault,
improper conduct, offence; unwholesome or improper
regimen.
अप-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing wrong, wicked, bad.

अपचाय् अप-चाय्, cl. 1. P. A. -चायति, -ते,
-यितुम्, to fear; to respect, honour.
अप-चायित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, respected.

अपचि 1. अप-चि, cl. 3. P., Ved. -चिकेति,
-चेतुम्, to pay attention to, to respect; to invite
respectfully.

अपचि 2. अप-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते,
-चेतुम्, to gather, collect: Pass. -चीयते, to be in-
jured in health or prosperity; to grow less; to wane;
(with abl.) to lose anything.

अप-ची, f. a disease consisting in an enlargement
of the glands of the neck.

अपाची, f. the south.
—अपाचीतरा (˚ची-इत्˚), f. the
north, i. e. other than the south.

1. अप-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, respected, sa-
luted; (अम्), n. honouring, esteeming.

2. अप-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, diminished, expended,
wasted; emaciated, thin.

1. अप-चिति, इस्, f. honouring, worship, reverence.
—अपचिति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, honoured.

2. अप-चिति, इस्, f. loss; expense; exclusion; com-
pensation; punishing; N. of a daughter of Marīci.

अप-चय, अस्, m. diminution, decay, decrease,
loss, privation, decline; N. of several planetary man-
sions.
अप-चेतृ, ता, m. a spendthrift.

अपचिकीर्षा अप-चिकीर्षा, f. (rt. कृ in
Desid.), desire of hurting any one.

अपचित् 1. अप-चित्, Caus. P. A. -चेतयति, -ते,
or Ved. -चितयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to become faithless:
Desid. -चिकितति, -ते, to wish to leave or to abandon
any one.
2. अप-चित्, त्, f., Ved. a noxious flying insect.

अपच्छत्त्र अप-च्छत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not having
a parasol.

अपच्छाय अप-च्छाय, अस्, आ, अम्, shadowless,
having no shadow, as a deity or celestial being; hav-
ing a bad or unlucky shadow; (आ), f. an unlucky
shadow, a phantom, apparition.

अपच्छेद अप-च्छेद, अस्, m. or अप-च्छेदन,
अम्, n. (rt. छिद्), cutting off or away; loss; inter-
ruption.

अपच्यु अप-च्यु, cl. 1. A. -च्यवते, poet. P.
-च्यवति, -च्योतुम्, to fall off, to perish, to go off,
desert, withdraw: Caus. -च्यावयति, to expel.

अप-च्यव, अस्, m., Ved. going or coming out;
moving down (as a pestle ?).

अप-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen off, departed, gone
away, perished.

अपजात अप-जात, अस्, m. a bad son who
has turned out ill.

अपजि अप-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to
defeat, conquer, to ward, off, keep off or out.
अप-जय, अस्, m. defeat, discomfiture, overthrow.

अप-जय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, conquerable, to be de-
feated.

अपजिघांसु अप-जिघांसु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. अप-
हन् in Desid.), desirous of keeping off, wishing to
avert.

अपजिहीर्षु अप-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. अप-
हृ, q. v., in Desid.), wishing to carry off or take away.

अपज्ञा अप-ज्ञा, cl. 9. A. -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्,
to deny, repudiate; to dissemble, conceal; to cause
not to be recognized.
अप-जानान, अस्, आ, अम्, denying, concealing.

अपञ्चीकृत अ-पञ्ची-कृत, अम्, n. simple
elementary substance, not compounded of the five
(पञ्चन्) gross elements; the five subtle elements.

अपटान्तर अ-पटान्तर (˚ट-अन्त्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
not separated by a curtain; adjoining, contiguous.

अपटी अपटी, f. a screen or wall of cloth,
especially the कनात् or screen surrounding a tent.
—अपटी-क्षेप or अपटा-क्षेप, अस्, m. tossing
aside the curtain; अपटी-क्षेपेण, with a toss of
the curtain, precipitate entrance on the stage, indi-
cating hurry and agitation.

अपटु अ-पटु, उस्, उस् or वी, उ, not clever,
awkward, uncouth; ineloquent; sick, diseased.
—अ-
पटु-ता, f. or अपटु-त्व, अम्, n. awkwardness;
sickness.

अपठ अ-पठ, अस्, m. unable to read, not
reading.

अपण्डित अ-पण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, unlearned,
illiterate.

अपण्य अ-पण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unsaleable, un-
fit for sale.

अपतक्ष् अप-तक्ष्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -तक्षति,
-षितुम् or -तष्टुम्, to chip off.

अपतन्त्रक अप-तन्त्रक, अस्, m. spasmodic
contraction of the body or stomach, emprosthotonos.

अपतानक अप-तानक, अस्, m. spasmodic
contraction.

अप-तानकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, affected with spasmodic
contraction.

अपति अ-पति, इस्, m., Ved. not a husband
or master; (इस्, इस्, इ), without a husband or master,
unmarried.
—अ-पति-घ्नी, f. not killing the husband.
—अपति-ता, f. state of being without a husband.
—अपति-पुत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without a husband and
children.
—अ-पति-व्रता, f. an unfaithful or unchaste
wife.
अप्पति अप्पति, इस्, m. See under अप्.
आ-पति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. coming in haste, rushing on.

आ-पत्ति, इस्, f. entering into a state or condition,
entering into relationship with anything, changing
into; obtaining, procuring; misfortune, calamity,
fault, transgression; remonstrance, expostulation.
अ-पतिक, अस्, आ, अम्, without a husband.

आ-पतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, accidental, unforeseen, sent
from heaven; (अस्), m. a hawk. a falcon.

अपतीर्थ अप-तीर्थ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bad or
improper Tīrtha, q. v.

अपतृप् अप-तृप्, Caus. P. -तर्पयति, -यि-
तुम्, to starve, cause to fast.
अप-तर्पण, अम्, n. fasting (in sickness).

अपत्त्र अ-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, leafless; (आ), f.,
N. of a plant.

अपात्र अ-पात्र, अम्, n. a worthless or

अप-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced; thrown away, re-
jected, dismissed, removed.
—अपविद्ध-पुत्र, अस्,
m. a son rejected by his natural parents and adopted
by a stranger; one of the twelve objects of filiation in
law.
—अपविद्ध-लोक, अस्, आ, अम्, dead.

अपविष अप-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
poison; (आ), f. a species of grass, Kyllingia Mono-
cephala.

अपविष्णु अप-विष्णु, ind. except or with-
out Viṣṇu.

अपवीण अप-वीण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bad
or no lute; (आ), f. a bad lute; (अम्), ind. without
a lute.

अपवीरवत् अ-पवीर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
not armed with a lance.

अपवृ अप-वृ, cl. 5. P. -वृणोति, -वरितुम्,
रीतुम्, to open, uncover, exhibit.

अपावृ अपा-वृ (अप-आ˚), cl. 5. P., Ved.
-वृणोति, -वरितुम्, -रीतुम्, to open; to cover; (in the
first sense अपावृ is said to be for अप-वृ, the final
of अप being lengthened.)

अप-वरण, अम्, n. covering, screening; gar-
ment.

अप-वारण, अम्, n. covering, concealment, dis-
appearance.

अप-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed, dis-
appeared.

अप-वारितक, अम्, n. concealed, secret manner;
अपवारितकेन, (in theatrical language) apart, aside
(speaking so that only the addressed person may
hear; opposed to प्रकाशम्).
अप-वार्य, ind. apart, aside; having concealed.
अप-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovered, opened.

अप-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reversed, inverted, over-
turned; ended; (अम्), n. ecliptic (in astronomy).

अपा-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, open, laid open; covered,
concealed, enclosed; unrestrained, self-willed.

अपा-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (with abl.) turned away
from; averted; abstaining from, rejecting, despising;
reversed, repelled; (अम्), n. the rolling on the ground
(of a horse).
अप-वृति, इस्, f. uncovering; concealing (?).
अप-वृत्ति, इस्, f. end.

अपा-वृति, इस्, f. or अपा-वरण, अम्, n. laying
open, enclosing, surrounding; covering, concealing,
screening.
अपा-वृत्ति, इस्, f. retreat, returning; repulse.

अपवृज् अप-वृज्, Caus. P. -वर्जयति, -यि-
तुम्, to quit, get rid of, to pay, to fulfil.

अप-वर्जन, अम्, n. abandoning, abandonment;
gift or donation, making good a promise, discharging
a debt or obligation; final emancipation or beati-
tude.

अप-वर्जनीय, or अप-वृज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
abandoned, to be avoided.

अप-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, quitted, got
rid of, given or cast away; made good as a promise,
discharged as a debt.
अप-वर्ज्य, ind. excepting, except.
अप-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completed.
अप-वृक्ति, इस्, f. fulfilment, completion.

अपवृत् अप-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -तितुम्,
to turn away, depart; to turn back, to come to an
end.

अपावृत् अपा-वृत् (अप-आ˚), cl. 1. A. -वर्तते,
-तितुम्, to turn away, to return, to abstain from, to
come to nought.
अपा-वृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. returning.
अप-वर्तक, अस्, m. a common measure.

अपा-वर्तन, अम्, n. turning away or from; re-
treat, returning; repulse.

अप-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away; removed;
divided by a common measure without remainder.

अपव्यध् अप-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति,
-व्यद्धुम्, to pierce badly, to throw away, to
neglect.

अप-वेध, अस्, m. piercing anything in the wrong
direction or manner (spoiling a jewel by so piercing
it).

अपव्यय अप-व्यय, अस्, m. (rt. इ with अप
and वि), prodigality.
अप-व्ययत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going away.

अप-व्ययमान, अस्, आ, अम्, squandering; deny-
ing a debt.

अप-व्ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ, squandering, wasting, pro-
digal.

अपव्यादा अप-व्य्-आ-दा (-वि-आ-दा), cl. 3. P.
-ददाति, -दातुम्, to open.

अपव्रत अप-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dis-
obedient, unfaithful; not performing holy acts, irre-
ligious; perverse.
अपशकुन अप-शकुन, अम्, n. a bad omen.

अपशङ्क अप-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless,
having no fear or hesitation; (अम्), ind. fearlessly.

अपशद अप-शद or अप-सद, अस्, m. a
low man.

अपसद अप-सद, अस्, m. the children of
six degrading connections, viz. of a Brāhman with
the women of the three lower classes, of a Kṣatriya
with women of the two lower, and of a Vaiśya with
one of the Sūdra; a low man; an outcast (in this
sense generally as last member of a comp., e. g.
ब्राह्मणापसद).

अपशब्द अप-शब्द, अस्, m. common or
vulgar speech; a bad word; any form of language
not Sanskrit^1; ungrammatical language. See अप-
भ्रंश.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20180314. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/Cologne/issues/215. note: Not a Sanskrit word.
अपशम अप-शम, अस्, m. cessation.

अपशिरस् अप-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or अप-शिर्-
ष, अस्, आ, अम्, or अप-शीर्षन्, आ, आ, अ, headless.

अपशु अ-पशु, उस्, m. not cattle; (उस्, उस्, उ),
deprived of cattle, poor.
—अ-पशु-हन्, हा, घ्नी, ह,
not killing cattle.
अपासु अपासु (अप-असु), उस्, उस्, उ, lifeless.

अपशुच् 1. अप-शुच्, Intens. P., Ved. -शो-
शोक्ति, to disappear, vanish.

2. अप-शुच्, क्, m. (without sorrow), the soul.
अप — शोक, अस्, आ, अम्, sorrowless; (अस्), m. a tree,
Jonesia Aśoka.

अपश्चादघ्वन् अ-पश्चा-दघ्वन् or अ-पश्चाद्-
दघ्वन्, आ, m., Ved. not staying behind; not
coming short of, not being a loser.

अपश्चिम अ-पश्चिम, अस्, आ, अम्, not having
another in the rear, last; having no end.

अपश्य अ-पश्य, अस्, आ, अम् Ved., or अ-पश्यत्,
-अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not seeing.

1. अपस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, active, fit for an act, running
away; watery; (आ), f. a kind of brick (twenty are
used in building the sacrificial altar); activity; water.
2. अपस्य, nom. P. अपस्यति, to be active.
अपस्य अपस्य, अपस्यु. See under अपस्.

अपाश्या अ-पाश्या, f. no great number of
noose or fetters (i. e. a few).

अपास्य, ind. having thrown away or discarded,
having left, having disregarded, having excepted.
अ-पश्यना, f. not seeing (?).

अपश्रय अप-श्रय, अस्, m., Ved. a bolster;
see उप-श्रय.

अपाश्रय 1. अपाश्रय (˚अप-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
helpless, destitute.

2. अपा-श्रय, अस्, m. refuge, recourse, the person
or thing to which recourse is had for refuge; an awn-
ing spread over a court or yard.
अपश्री अप-श्री, ईस्, इ, deprived of beauty.

अपाश्रि 1. अपा-श्रि (अप-आ˚), cl. 1. P. -श्र-
यति, -यितुम्, to resort to; to use, practice.

अपश्वास अप-श्वास, अस्, m. one of the five
vital airs; see अपान.

अपष्ठ अप-ष्ठ, अम्, n. (rt. स्था), the end
or point of the hook for driving an elephant.

अपाष्ठ अपा-ष्ठ, अस्, m., Ved. barb of an
arrow; (अम्), n. what remains of the Soma plant
after it has been pressed out.
—अपाष्ठ-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, Ved. having barbs; (वत्), ind. like the re-
mainder of the Soma plant (?).

अप-ष्ठुर or अप-ष्ठुल, अस्, आ, अम्, oppo-
site, contrary.

अपस् अपस्, अस्, n. (fr. obs. rt. अप्), Ved.
work, action; sacred act, sacrificial act; water; (आस्),
m. f. (असस्), m. f. pl., Ved. active, skilful in any art:
अपसस्, f. pl., is a name of the hands and fingers
which are busy in kindling the sacred fire and in
performing the sacrifices; also a name of the three
goddesses of sacred speech, or of the three divinities,
fire, wind, and sun; also of the active or running
waters [cf. Lat. opus].

आपस् आपस्, n. a religious ceremony;
water (see अप्); sin [cf. अपस्].

अपस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम् (superl.), Ved. most active
or rapid.
अपस्तम अपस्-तम. See under अपस्.
अपस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. active.
अपसमम् अप-समम्, ind. last year (?).

अपसर्जन अप-सर्जन, अम्, n. (rt. सृज्),
abandonment; gift or donation; final emancipation
of the soul [cf. अप-वृज्].

अपसलवि अप-सलवि, ind., Ved. to the
left (opposed to प्र-सलवि); the space between the
thumb and the forefinger (sacred to the Manes).

अपसव्य अप-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, or अप-
सव्यक, अस्, इका, अम्, not on the left side, right;
opposite, contrary; (अम्), ind. to the right; the
same as अप-सलवि.
—अपसव्यं कृ = प्रदक्-
षिणं कृ, to circumambulate a person keeping
the right side towards him; to put the sacred cord
on the right shoulder.
—अपसव्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having the sacred thread worn on the right shoulder,
(as during a Śrāddha, &c.)

अपसिद्धान्त अप-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m. (rt. 1.
सिध्), an erroneous conclusion.

अपसिध् अप-सिध्, cl. 1. P. -सेधति, -सेद्-
धुम्, -सेधितुम्, to ward off, remove, drive away.

अपसृ अप-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to
walk off, go away: Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to make
or let one go away, to remove.
अप-सर, अस्, m. excuse, apology.

अप-सार, अस्, m. going out; egress, passage for
going forth; escape.

अप-सरण, अम्, n. going away. retreating;
egress.
अप-सारण, अम्, n. removing to a distance.

अपासरण अपा-सरण, अम्, n. (rt. सृ), de-
parting, departure, removal.

अप-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, removed, put away,
thrown aside.

अपसृप् अप-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्-
तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to glide or move off.

अप-सर्प or अप-सर्पक, अस्, m. a secret emis-
sary or agent, spy.
अप-सर्पण, अम्, n. going back, retreating.
अप-सृप्ति, इस्, f. going away.

अपस्कम्भ अप-स्कम्भ, अस्, m. Ved. fasten-
ing, making firm.

अपस्कर अप-स्कर, अस्, m. any part of a
carriage, a wheel, &c.; fæces; anus; vulva.

अप-स्कार, अस्, m. the root or under part of the
knee.

आपस्कार आपस्कार, अम्, n. (fr. अप-स्कर),
the root or extremity of the trunk or body.

अपस्खल अप-स्खल, अस्, m. leaping off,
jumping off; outside of a threshing floor (?).

अपस्तम्भ अप-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. a vessel in
the side of the breast containing vital air.
अप-स्तम्भिनी, f., N. of a plant.

आपस्तम्भिनी आपस्तम्भिनी, f., N. of a plant,
perhaps Eriocaulon Quinquangulare Lin.

अपस्नात अप-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed or
bathing after death or mourning, or upon the death of
a connection, preparatory to other ceremonies.

अप-स्नान, अम्, n. funeral bathing, upon the
death of a connection, after mourning, &c.; impure
bathing, or bathing in water in which a person has
previously washed.

अपस्पति अपस्-पति, इस्, m., N. of a son of
Uttānapāda.

अपस्पृश् 1. अप-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृशति,
-स्पर्ष्टुम्, -स्प्रष्टुम्, to touch.

2. अप-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. not letting one's self
be touched.

अपस्पृश् 3. अ-पस्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. not
touching, not hurting.

अप-स्पर्श, अस्, आ, अम्, having no touch, insen-
sible.

अपस्फिग अप-स्फिग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has badly formed buttocks; (अम्), ind. except the
buttocks.

अपस्फुर् अप-स्फुर्, ऊस्, ऊस्, ऊस्, or अप-
स्फुर, अस्, आ, अम्, or अप-स्फुरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्
Ved. bounding or bursting forth, swelling, increasing.
According to native authorities, both अप-स्फुर
and अप-स्फुरत् may mean ‘injured.’
अप-स्फुर्; for ‘ऊस्, ऊस्, ऊस्,’ read ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्.

अपस्मार अप-स्मार, अस्, m. or अप-स्मृति,
इस्, f. forgetfulness; epilepsy, falling sickness.
अप-स्मारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, epileptic, convulsed.
अप-स्मृति, इस्, इस्, इ, forgetful.

अपस्वर अप-स्वर, अस्, m. an unmusical
note or sound.

अपहन् अप-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -तुम्, to
beat off, ward off, repel, destroy.

अप-ह, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping back, repelling, re-
moving, destroying (e. g. शोकापह, अस्, आ, अम्,
removing sorrow).

अपहा 1. अप-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, -हातुम्,
to go off, come to an end.

अपहा 2. अप-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति, -हातुम्,
to leave, abandon.

अपाहा अपा-हा (अप-आ˚), cl. 3. P. -जहाति,
हातुम्, to leave, omit, reject.
अप-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, warded off, killed.
अप-हति, इस्, f. removing, destroying.

अप-हनन, अम्, n. or अप-घात (q. v.), ward-
ing off.
अप-हन्तृ, ता, m. beating off, destroying.

अपहल अप-हल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bad
plough.

अपहस् अप-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -सितुम्,
to deride: Caus. P. -हासयति, -यितुम्, to deride,
ridicule.

अप-हसित, अम्, n. or अप-हास, अस्, m. silly or
causeless laughter.
अप-हास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be laughed at.

अपहस्त अप-हस्त, अम्, n. taking or throw-
ing away or off; stealing, plundering.

अप-हस्त; add — अस्, m. the back of the hand
(= हस्त-पृष्ठ).

अप-हस्तय, nom. P. अप-हस्तयति, -यितुम्,
to throw away, lose.

अप-हस्तय; add — to drive away (with the back
of the hand).

अप-हस्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away, lost, parted
with.

अप-हान, अस्, आ, अम् (or fr. 1. अप-हा?), leaving,
abandoning; also written अप-हायन.

अप-हानि, इस्, f. leaving; leaving off, abandonment,
stopping, vanishing; exception, exclusion.

अप-हाय, ind. leaving out of view, excepting,
except, besides.
अपा-हाय, ind. excepting; except.

अपहिङ्कार अप-हिङ्-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, without
the syllable हिम्, which is pronounced in singing the
Sāma verses.

अपहृ अप-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. (?) -हरति, -ते,
-हर्तुम्, to snatch away, carry off, plunder; to re-
move, to throw away: Caus. -हारयति, -यितुम्,
to have (anything) carried off.

अप-हरण, अम्, n. taking away, carrying off;
stealing.
अप-हारण, अम्, n. causing to take away, spoiling.

अप-हर्तृ, ता, m. (with gen. or acc.) taking
away; expiating.

अप-हार, अस्, m. taking away, stealing; spending
another person's property; secreting, concealment;
e. g. आत्मापहारं कृ, to conceal one's real cha-
racter.

अप-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अप-हारिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, one who takes away, seizes, steals, &c.; a plun-
derer, a thief.

अप-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, carried off,
stolen, &c.; taken back, resumed.
—अपहृत-वि-
ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, bereft of sense.
अपहेला अप-हेला, f. disrespect, contempt.

अपह्नु अप-ह्नु, cl. 2. A. -ह्नुते, -ह्नोतुम्,
to conceal, disguise; to refuse, deny, disown.
अप-ह्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, concealed, denied.

अप-ह्नुति, इस्, f. denial, concealment of know-
ledge; a figure of rhetoric, applying a description or
simile to other than its obvious application.
अप-ह्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, denying.

अप-ह्नोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who conceals or
denies or disowns.

अपह्रास अप-ह्रास, अस्, m. diminishing,
reducing.

अपाक् अपाक्, ind. westward, southward;
see अपाच् next col.

अपाक 1. अपाक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अप), situated
aside or behind; distant; coming from a distant
place; incomparable.
—अपाक-चक्षस्, आस्, m., Ved.
looking or shining far; of incomparable brightness.

अपाका or अपाकात्, ind., Ved. aside, distant.
—अपा-
के-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing behind.

आपाक आ-पाक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पच् with आ),
a baking oven, a potter's kiln.
—आपाके-स्थ, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. standing in an oven.
अपाक्तात्, ind., Ved. from behind, from the west.

अपपाक 2. अ-पाक, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. पच्), im-
mature, raw, unripe, undigested; (अस्), m. immaturity,
indigestion.
—अ-पाक-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, not produced
by cooking or ripening; original; natural.
